lore.common: Copies the microwave beep so perfectly that the family keeps opening an empty microwave.
lore.uncommon: Learns every word you say, especially the ones you didn't mean to say in front of guests.
lore.rare: Can count to six and name every colour, so it always knows exactly how many biscuits you hid, and where.
lore.epic: Phoned for a pizza in its owner's voice and ordered forty with extra peanuts.
lore.legendary: Learned every language in the city by listening at the bus stop, then got a job as the airport's announcer.

lore.common: Looks very serious and important, then steals a fish from a smaller bird.
lore.uncommon: Has a fierce face but a squeaky little call, so it glares extra hard to make up for it.
lore.rare: Only gets its white head at five years old, and spends the years before that insisting it is not a teenager.
lore.epic: Built a nest so enormous on top of a cliff that hikers mistake it for a hut.
lore.legendary: Soared so high over the canyon that it saw tomorrow's weather and warned the farmers.

names.legendary: Waggle, Bane of the Busy Bee

lore.common: Catches a bee, bashes it on a branch, then expects applause for its table manners.
lore.uncommon: Digs its nest tunnel in a sandy riverbank, so it comes out every morning with sand in its feathers and a grumpy face.
lore.rare: Can catch a bee mid-air from the far side of the meadow, then catch its friend on the way back.
lore.epic: Raided every beehive in the valley in one afternoon. The beekeepers now wear bird costumes to scare it.
lore.legendary: Flew in from Africa every summer for so long that the bees started arriving a week late on purpose.

names.legendary: Robin Featherbright, Song of the Street

lore.common: Builds a nest in the gutter every spring, then complains loudly every time it rains.
lore.uncommon: Taps on the window every morning to tell you the bird feeder is empty.
lore.rare: Starts the dawn chorus at four in the morning, and expects the whole street to join in.
lore.epic: Gathered every sparrow in town on one telephone wire, which sagged so low that the postman had to limbo under it.
lore.legendary: Sang so sweetly from the TV aerial that the whole street turned its radios off for the summer. The radio station sent a sulky letter.

names.legendary: Lord Lyre, Dancer of the Moor

lore.common: Struts round the field at dawn fluffing its tail and expects everyone to watch.
lore.uncommon: Makes a bubbling cooing sound like a kettle that won't boil.
lore.rare: Has bright red eyebrows that swell up when it shows off, so it always looks surprised at itself.
lore.epic: Held a staring match with a rival for so long that the sheep built a little grandstand.
lore.legendary: Won every dance contest on the moor for so many years that the hills are named after its moves.

names.legendary: Bramble, Leader of a Million Wings

lore.common: Arrives at the bird feeder with ten friends and empties it in a minute.
lore.uncommon: Its orange chest glows like a tiny bonfire in the winter snow.
lore.rare: Finds every beech nut in the forest and leaves the squirrels nothing.
lore.epic: Arrived with a flock so huge that the whole sky went dark for an afternoon. Street lights came on.
lore.legendary: Swaps its orange winter feathers for a smart black head every spring, and was let into a fancy restaurant without a tie.

lore.common: Sings loudly and cheerfully outside your window at sunrise, every single day.
lore.uncommon: Picks the ripest fruit off the tree the morning before you were going to pick it.
lore.rare: Has a bright red patch under its tail and sits facing away from you so you cannot miss it.
lore.epic: Started a choir of bulbuls in the town square that drowned out the church bells.
lore.legendary: Built its nest in a hanging flowerpot and would not let anyone water the plant all spring. The petunias are very thirsty.

names.legendary: Old Coucal, Drum of the Marsh

lore.common: Walks everywhere because it can't be bothered to fly, then complains about its feet.
lore.uncommon: Makes a deep hooting coop-coop sound like water glugging out of a bottle.
lore.rare: Clambers through the hedge so clumsily that the gardener thinks a dog is stuck in it.
lore.epic: Hooted across the marsh until every frog in the swamp lost its rhythm.
lore.legendary: Is a cuckoo that actually raises its own chicks, and tells every other cuckoo about it, loudly, all summer.

names.legendary: Queen Hornbilla of the Sealed Tree

lore.common: Its huge beak gets stuck in the bird feeder every single time.
lore.uncommon: Has a big hollow helmet on its beak, so its calls echo like someone shouting into a bucket.
lore.rare: Its wings whoosh so loudly when it flies that it sounds like a passing train.
lore.epic: Stripped a whole fig tree in one visit, and the forest had to wait until next year for pudding.
lore.legendary: Sealed itself inside the grandest tree in the forest and ran the whole jungle from there by post.

lore.common: Is so blue that people think someone painted it, and keep trying to wash it.
lore.uncommon: Finds its way home by looking at the stars, then lands in the same tree every year.
lore.rare: Learns its song from the bird next door, so whole streets of buntings sing with the same accent.
lore.epic: Turned up at the woodland edge with a hundred blue friends, and the bluebell walk was cancelled because nobody could tell which was which.
lore.legendary: Is so perfectly blue that the paint makers tried to copy it for years and gave up.

lore.common: Snaps at every butterfly it sees, then lets the boring ones go.
lore.uncommon: Its feathers shine like metal in the sun. It checks its reflection in every puddle.
lore.rare: Sits so still on one branch that it can wait an hour for the perfect insect, then claims it was meditating.
lore.epic: Dug its nest tunnel into a termite mound, and the termites spent a week asking who had moved in upstairs.
lore.legendary: Caught the fastest butterfly in the world after a chase that lasted a whole afternoon. Then let it go to be fair.

lore.common: Hops around under the bird feeder picking up what the other birds dropped. It says it's helping.
lore.uncommon: Flashes the white feathers on the sides of its tail whenever it flies away, like a little signal.
lore.rare: Arrives exactly when the first snow falls, every year, as if it booked the date.
lore.epic: Led a flock of snowbirds so big into a car park that every car looked like it had a hat.
lore.legendary: Has worn the same grey suit with a white belly every day of its life, and was finally voted best dressed by the snowmen.

lore.common: Screeches so loudly at the bird feeder that the neighbours think there's a car alarm.
lore.uncommon: Licks nectar out of flowers with a tongue like a little paintbrush.
lore.rare: Flew into the café and drank every glass of juice in one go. The staff is still cleaning.
lore.epic: Arrived in the park with a flock so loud and colourful that the fireworks display was cancelled.
lore.legendary: Turned a grey city rainbow-coloured by perching on every rooftop at once. The tourists came for a month.

names.legendary: Lady Partridge of the Pear Tree

lore.common: Runs instead of flying away, then hides behind a cow as if it was never there.
lore.uncommon: Scurries along the ground with its whole family in a line, like a small train.
lore.rare: Bursts out of the hedge so suddenly that walkers drop their sandwiches.
lore.epic: Laid twenty eggs in one nest and the whole field had to tiptoe for a month.
lore.legendary: Became the star of the most famous Christmas song in history and has refused to leave the pear tree since.

lore.common: Puffs up two orange balloons on its neck every morning and booms like a bassoon.
lore.uncommon: Stamps its feet in a dance so fast that it looks like it's running on the spot.
lore.rare: Raises two feather tufts on its head like horns, and is very disappointed when nobody runs away.
lore.epic: Booms from the same hill every spring, and has done for so long that the map now calls it Boom Hill.
lore.legendary: Danced so magnificently that every bird on the prairie came to watch, including two very jealous peacocks.

lore.common: Turns white in winter and then gets lost in the snow on its way home.
lore.uncommon: Has feathery feet like slippers, so it walks on snow while everyone else sinks.
lore.rare: Dives into a snowdrift to sleep in a snug little cave, and will not come out for anyone holding a shovel.
lore.epic: Croaked so much like a creaky door that every mountain hut on the pass checked its hinges.
lore.legendary: Blended into the snow so well that it watched every ski race at the winter games from the finish line.

lore.common: Beats its wings so loudly on a log that people think there's a motorbike in the woods.
lore.uncommon: Puffs out a ruff of feathers round its neck like a fancy collar.
lore.rare: Exploded out of the leaves so suddenly that a hiker dropped their map into the river.
lore.epic: Drummed so loudly on a fallen log that every rabbit in the forest started dancing.
lore.legendary: Walked across the whole snowy forest on its fringed winter toes, and the snowshoe hares asked for the pattern.

names.legendary: Lady Sulphura, Bin Queen of the Suburbs

lore.common: Hangs upside down from the gutter to stare in at breakfast, then screams when nobody shares.
lore.uncommon: Raises its yellow crest when it is excited, so the whole street knows it has found something it should not have.
lore.rare: Learned to lift the lid of every wheelie bin in the street and taught all its friends.
lore.epic: Chewed through every wooden balcony railing on the street in one week. The builders now arrive with metal ones and a nervous look.
lore.legendary: Lived past a hundred, outlasting three owners, two houses and every bin lid ever designed to stop it.

lore.common: Bobs up and down on a rock in the stream like it's listening to music.
lore.uncommon: Walks straight into the river and keeps going underwater, looking for snacks.
lore.rare: Blinks its bright white eyelids while bobbing, like a tiny lighthouse flashing messages to the fish.
lore.epic: Built its mossy nest right behind a waterfall, so every visitor gets soaked just to say hello.
lore.legendary: Sang right through the roar of the loudest waterfall in the mountains, and the waterfall turned itself down to listen.

names.legendary: Henrietta, the Hen Who Ruled the Roost

lore.common: Lays an egg and then tells the whole farm about it for twenty minutes.
lore.uncommon: Crosses the road just to see if anyone is going to ask why.
lore.rare: Crows at dawn, noon, teatime and midnight, just to make sure everyone is awake.
lore.epic: Started a pecking order argument that spread to every farm in the valley.
lore.legendary: Laid a golden egg, a silver egg and a chocolate egg in the same week, then demanded a pay rise.

lore.common: Is so tiny that it gets lost in a teaspoon of sea water.
lore.uncommon: Glows softly in the dark sea, so the fish think it's a tiny night light.
lore.rare: Swims in a swarm so thick that the sea turns pink.
lore.epic: Formed a swarm so huge that a whale opened its mouth and gave up because it couldn't decide where to start.
lore.legendary: Has more of itself in the ocean than there are people on land, and still gets lost in a teaspoon.

lore.common: Is so see-through that you can watch its breakfast going down. It really wishes you would look away.
lore.uncommon: Flicks its tail and shoots backwards whenever someone looks at it.
lore.rare: Cleans fish in the rockpool and charges them in tiny shells.
lore.epic: Shot backwards so fast through the rockpool that every crab in it got its claws tangled.
lore.legendary: Escaped from every net in the harbour by swimming backwards, and now runs a rockpool cleaning business.

lore.common: Throws sticks in the air and catches them for no reason, then looks round to see who was impressed.
lore.uncommon: Dances with its wings outstretched every time it meets a friend at the pond.
lore.rare: Inspired a thousand paper cranes and now insists on folding its own.
lore.epic: Gathered with ten thousand cranes on one lake, and their trumpeting rattled every window in the valley for a week.
lore.legendary: Flew over the highest mountains in the world with its flock, then grumbled that they could have been a bit lower.

names.legendary: Commander Coot of the Duck Pond

lore.common: Runs across the pond splashing loudly instead of flying, like a very wet sprinter.
lore.uncommon: Has funny lobed toes instead of webbed feet and shows them off to the ducks.
lore.rare: Bosses every duck on the pond into a different corner, then sits in the middle.
lore.epic: Fought a rival coot by sitting back and kicking water at it for an hour. The rowing club stopped to cheer.
lore.legendary: Built a floating nest out of reeds and crisp packets so big that the park added it to the map as an island.

lore.common: Stands perfectly still in the pond for so long that people think it is a garden ornament.
lore.uncommon: Grows beautiful white plumes and preens them in front of every puddle.
lore.rare: Tosses every fish in the air to swallow it head-first. Misses about once a week and calls it a juggling trick.
lore.epic: Shuffled its feet in the shallows so hard that every fish in the marsh shot onto the bank and asked for a towel.
lore.legendary: Grew such magnificent white plumes that every swan on the lake booked a hairdresser.

lore.common: Points its beak at the sky and sways with the reeds, hoping you'll mistake it for a reed.
lore.uncommon: Booms like a foghorn across the marsh so the ships think there's a lighthouse.
lore.rare: Hid in the reeds so well that the birdwatchers walked past it a dozen times.
lore.epic: Boomed so loudly at night that the fishing boats turned round and headed for shore.
lore.legendary: Has never been seen by a single birdwatcher, only heard. They now call it the marsh's best-kept secret.

lore.common: Hides in the trees whenever anyone looks, then complains nobody notices it.
lore.uncommon: Wears a bright red beak and red legs with an all-black suit, and insists it is not dressed for a party.
lore.rare: Wades through streams so quietly that the fish think it's a branch.
lore.epic: Crossed the whole Sahara on warm air without a single flap, then complained about the sand in its feathers.
lore.legendary: Hid so well in the forest for a whole year that the birdwatchers gave up and threw it a farewell party. It watched from a tree and ate the cake.

lore.common: Walks everywhere very slowly to save energy, and is deeply offended whenever a hare overtakes it.
lore.uncommon: Puffs itself up into a ball of white feathers to impress anyone nearby.
lore.rare: Is one of the heaviest flying birds, and makes sure the ground knows when it lands.
lore.epic: Landed on the village cricket pitch with such a thump that the bails fell off at both ends.
lore.legendary: Took off at one end of the plain and landed at the other. The ground has asked for some warning next time.

names.legendary: Dowager Dowitch, Queen of the Mud

lore.common: Pokes its long beak into the mud so fast that it looks like a sewing machine.
lore.uncommon: Has a beak almost as long as its body and keeps knocking on things it did not mean to.
lore.rare: Feels worms through the mud with the very tip of its beak, so it finds dinner with its eyes shut, and often does.
lore.epic: Landed on the mudflat with ten thousand friends all stitching at once. The dog walkers thought the beach had started to purr.
lore.legendary: Stitched the entire beach together with its beak in one afternoon. The sand now stays put.

names.legendary: Sir Quacksworth, Admiral of the Pond

lore.common: Quacks loudly at anyone carrying bread, and gets very cross if it's toast.
lore.uncommon: Waddles across the road with its ducklings in a perfect line and stops all the traffic.
lore.rare: Water slides right off its back, so it splashes everyone else and stays dry.
lore.epic: Led a parade of a hundred ducks through the high street. The shops gave out free bread.
lore.legendary: Slept with one eye open for so long that it watched the whole park being rebuilt. It has notes about the new benches.

names.legendary: Gallinula, Queen of the Lily Pads

lore.common: Struts across the lily pads with its long toes and pretends it can walk on water.
lore.uncommon: Flicks its tail with every step like it's always slightly annoyed.
lore.rare: Its bright purple feathers shine so much that the dragonflies keep landing on it.
lore.epic: Climbed the reeds like a ladder and was found on top of the boathouse roof, looking innocent.
lore.legendary: Holds its food in one foot like a sandwich, and was finally invited to the lakeside cafe, where it ordered everything with its toes.

lore.common: Walks with a funny limp and insists it's just its style.
lore.uncommon: Wails so loudly at night that people think there's a ghost in the swamp.
lore.rare: Pulls snails out of their shells so neatly that the snails don't notice until it's too late.
lore.epic: Left so many empty snail shells on the riverbank that hermit crabs came inland to go house-hunting.
lore.legendary: Limped so stylishly through the swamp that every heron started copying the walk. It is now a dance craze.

lore.common: Stands so still in the shallows that it once fell asleep standing up.
lore.uncommon: Starts life completely white and slowly turns blue, which it says took a lot of effort.
lore.rare: Can stab a fish with its beak before the fish has finished deciding to swim away.
lore.epic: Waded into the town fountain and fished so calmly that a crowd gathered. It caught one fish, bowed, and flew off.
lore.legendary: Caught a fish at every pond in the county in a single day, then had a long, slow, very blue nap.

lore.common: Shouts "peep peep peep" at anything that moves on the beach, including waves.
lore.uncommon: Opens mussels with its bright orange beak like it's using a little screwdriver.
lore.rare: Hammers limpets off the rocks with such a rat-a-tat that the woodpeckers want to know who the new drummer is.
lore.epic: Laid its eggs in the middle of the seafront car park, and the whole town parked somewhere else for a month.
lore.legendary: Ran the busiest shellfish stall on the coast with nothing but its beak, and never once cracked a shell wrong.

names.legendary: Sandy Redback, Dancer of the Tide

lore.common: Runs away from every wave, then runs back after it, then away again, all day.
lore.uncommon: Changes its feathers to red in summer and looks very pleased with itself.
lore.rare: Swirls with its flock so tightly that it looks like one big bird made of smaller birds.
lore.epic: Paddled its feet in the mud so fast that worms popped up all along the beach to see what the noise was.
lore.legendary: Flew halfway around the world without stopping, then landed on the same beach as last year and asked where its towel was.

lore.common: Screams the alarm at everything, including a leaf falling in the wind.
lore.uncommon: Has bright red legs and pretends not to notice when people point at them.
lore.rare: Sweeps its beak through the shallows like a metal detector and beeps proudly whenever it finds a shrimp.
lore.epic: Raised such a loud alarm on the marsh that every bird took off at once and left the hunter alone with a sandwich.
lore.legendary: Nested beside the eighteenth hole and made every golfer tiptoe past for a whole summer. Nobody has ever played so quietly.

lore.common: Turns over every stone on the beach looking for snacks, then puts none of them back.
lore.uncommon: Flips seaweed, shells and the odd lost flip-flop to see what's underneath.
lore.rare: Turned over a rock so big that it surprised the crab, the fisherman and itself.
lore.epic: Ate the leftover chips off every bench on the seafront before the seagulls woke up. The seagulls now set alarms.
lore.legendary: Flew from the Arctic to Australia and flipped one stone at every stop, just in case. Says it has nearly finished.

names.legendary: Lady Spoonbella of the Pink Lagoon

lore.common: Sweeps its spoon-shaped beak through the water and then complains there's no soup.
lore.uncommon: Swings its head side to side in the water like it's stirring a giant pot.
lore.rare: Has a bald greenish head, which it says keeps it cool and is definitely a fashion choice.
lore.epic: Roosted with two hundred friends in one tree, which turned so pink that the tourists photographed it as blossom.
lore.legendary: Was hired by the finest restaurant in town to stir its soup. Nobody else has been allowed near the pot since.

lore.common: Builds its nest on the chimney and then complains about the smoke.
lore.uncommon: Clatters its beak like castanets to say hello, which wakes the whole village.
lore.rare: Decorates its nest with whatever it finds, and the village has quietly lost one sock from every washing line.
lore.epic: Built nests on every roof in the village. The village is now officially a bird sanctuary.
lore.legendary: Delivered so many bundles to the village, according to the old stories, that the postman has asked it to cover weekends.

lore.common: Stares at divers with its pointy teeth and refuses to blink first.
lore.uncommon: Shoots through the water like an arrow and arrives before it has even decided where to go.
lore.rare: Bites straight through fishing line, then hangs around the boat to see whether you have any more.
lore.epic: Followed a fishing boat all the way into harbour and tried to buy a ticket for the return trip.
lore.legendary: Became the fastest fish on the reef and won every race, even the ones it wasn't entered in.

lore.common: Swims upstream every year and complains the river is flowing the wrong way.
lore.uncommon: Leaps up waterfalls like they are small steps.
lore.rare: Jumped over a bear waiting at the waterfall and landed on the other side, laughing.
lore.epic: Jumped so many waterfalls in one week that the river put up a sign saying PLEASE USE THE STAIRS.
lore.legendary: Turned such a bright red for its journey home that the lighthouse switched off and let the coho do the job.

lore.common: Gives a tiny zap to anyone who steps on it, then pretends nothing happened.
lore.uncommon: Can light up a small torch just by sitting near it.
lore.rare: Zapped a diver's camera so the photos all came out fizzy.
lore.epic: Hid under the sand at a swimming beach and gave everyone a mild tickle. The beach shut for the day.
lore.legendary: Powered an entire underwater research station for a month without being asked. The scientists sent a thank-you card.

lore.common: Swims round its bowl all day and acts surprised to see the same plastic castle every time.
lore.uncommon: Blows bubbles at the glass whenever someone walks past, to say hello or to complain.
lore.rare: Ate its food so fast that it spun round the bowl ten times and needed a lie down.
lore.epic: Jumped out of its bowl into the big tank next door and declared itself the new boss. The angelfish take turns to complain.
lore.legendary: Lived forty years in the same bowl, outlasting three castles and two plastic divers, and is still surprised by the castle.

lore.common: Floats like a stick in the swamp and enjoys scaring the fishermen.
lore.uncommon: Its scales are so tough that it can bump into rocks without noticing.
lore.rare: Gulps air at the surface so loudly that anglers spin round looking for whoever burped.
lore.epic: Shot through the swamp like a torpedo and every frog jumped out of the water.
lore.legendary: Has looked exactly the same for a hundred million years, and says it is waiting for fashion to come back round.

lore.common: Checks its reflection in every diver's mask and pretends it's looking at the diver.
lore.uncommon: Its yellow and black colours are so bright that the coral gets jealous.
lore.rare: Turns from yellow with a black spot as a baby to mostly black as a grown-up, and says it is just going through a phase.
lore.epic: Nibbled every sponge on the reef in one week, and the divers came up asking where all the furniture had gone.
lore.legendary: Became the most photographed fish in the ocean and now has its own reef with a velvet rope around it.

names.legendary: Sturgeonius, the Oldest of the River

lore.common: Sifts through the mud at the bottom of the river and complains that everything tastes of mud.
lore.uncommon: Has armour plates instead of scales and walks along the riverbed like a tank.
lore.rare: Jumped out of the river so high that a passing boat had to duck.
lore.epic: Swam through the river so slowly and powerfully that the river had to wait for it to pass.
lore.legendary: Has lived in the same river for over a hundred years and knows the names of every fish that ever swam in it.

lore.common: Waves its tentacles at every passing fish, then gets cross when they don't wave back.
lore.uncommon: Lets the clownfish live in its tentacles and charges rent in crumbs.
lore.rare: Fires sticky threads at anything that touches it, so every curious shrimp gets a surprise handshake.
lore.epic: Grew so many friends in one rockpool that it became the most popular garden on the beach.
lore.legendary: Walked very slowly across the reef on its one foot to find a better view. It took a year, and the view was worth it.

lore.common: Looks like a giant brain, so the fish ask it for help with their homework.
lore.uncommon: Grows so slowly that it's still thinking about what happened last year.
lore.rare: Solved every puzzle the reef had in one tide, mostly by staying very still.
lore.epic: Grew so big that it became a reef all by itself and the fish moved in.
lore.legendary: Has been growing for nine hundred years and is now the size of a car. The fish call it the library.

names.legendary: Medusa Moonglow, Queen of the Drift

lore.common: Floats around with no idea where it's going and is still always late.
lore.uncommon: Glows softly in the dark sea like a forgotten lamp.
lore.rare: Has no brain at all and still beats everyone at floating. Says thinking is overrated.
lore.epic: Gathered thousands of jellyfish into a swarm that turned the whole bay into a glowing lantern show.
lore.legendary: Turns back into a baby whenever it gets old, and refuses to tell anyone its real age.

lore.common: Squirts ink whenever it's surprised, so every photo of it is just black.
lore.uncommon: Can open a jar from the inside, then complains that the jar was empty.
lore.rare: Changes colour to match whatever it's sitting on, including a chessboard.
lore.epic: Escaped from the aquarium tank every night to visit the other tanks, then went back before morning.
lore.legendary: Learned eight hobbies at once, one per arm, and still dropped the knitting the moment someone opened a jar.

lore.common: Hoots outside your window every night at exactly the wrong time.
lore.uncommon: Turns its head almost all the way round to see who's behind it, then turns it back looking smug.
lore.rare: Flies so silently that it lands on the gatepost and nobody notices for an hour.
lore.epic: Moved into the old barn, and every mouse in the county stayed indoors for the whole winter.
lore.legendary: Knew the answer to every question in the forest and opened a night school. All the lessons start at midnight.

lore.common: Waddles everywhere so slowly that it slides on its belly when it's in a hurry.
lore.uncommon: Huddles in the middle of the group in winter and never takes a turn on the outside.
lore.rare: Swims so fast underwater that it shoots out onto the ice like a cork.
lore.epic: Jumped off the ice edge first, and ten thousand penguins followed it into the sea like a very long, very wet queue.
lore.legendary: Waddled all the way across the South Pole to deliver a single pebble to its best friend.

lore.common: Clicks and whistles loudly at the boat and won't stop until someone waves.
lore.uncommon: Leaps out of the water in perfect arcs whenever it notices people watching.
lore.rare: Raced alongside a ferry and won, then did a backflip to celebrate.
lore.epic: Taught its whole pod to surf the bow waves of every boat in the bay. The sailing school has lost all its pupils to them.
lore.legendary: Guided a lost ship safely through a foggy channel by leaping in front of it. The captain named the ship after it.

names.legendary: Grey Gertrude, Wanderer of the Pacific

lore.common: Rubs barnacles off its back on the seabed and then sulks that they come back.
lore.uncommon: Swims right up to the little boats in the lagoon and waits to have its head scratched like a very large dog.
lore.rare: Scoops up mud from the seabed with its mouth and sifts out tiny shrimp like a giant sieve.
lore.epic: Scooped up so much seabed in one dive that it left whale-shaped pits for the crabs to move into.
lore.legendary: Swims from the icy north to the warm south and back every year, and still gets grumpy if another whale is in its favourite lagoon.

lore.common: Circles the boat for an hour and then swims off because it was only curious.
lore.uncommon: Grows new teeth whenever it loses one, so it always has a brand new smile.
lore.rare: Can smell a single drop of tuna in a swimming pool from the far end.
lore.epic: Patrolled the reef so thoroughly that every fish now swims in neat lines.
lore.legendary: Has swum the oceans since before there were trees, and still thinks trees are a passing fad.

lore.common: Spouts water from its blowhole right when someone has just dried their hair.
lore.uncommon: Sings long songs that travel across the whole ocean, then complains that nobody sings back.
lore.rare: Breached out of the water so high that a seagull landed on its nose.
lore.epic: Did a belly flop in the bay and the wave washed every beach towel up onto the promenade.
lore.legendary: Swallowed a krill swarm the size of a swimming pool in one gulp, then burped up a small rain cloud.

lore.common: Sticks to a rock with its tentacles to sleep, and snores out bubbles all night.
lore.uncommon: Floats up and down by changing the air inside its spiral shell, like a tiny submarine.
lore.rare: Has ninety little tentacles and no suckers, so it holds hands with everything by accident.
lore.epic: Spun through the deep sea so fast in its spiral shell that it left a whirlpool behind.
lore.legendary: Has been swimming in the same shape for millions of years and says the design is perfect, thank you.

lore.common: Clings to the rock so tightly that the tide gives up trying to move it.
lore.uncommon: Has a tiny eye at the tip of every arm, so it always knows who is sneaking up, from any direction.
lore.rare: Opened a mussel with its arms in one slow, very determined afternoon.
lore.epic: Led a dance of starfish across the rockpools at low tide, spinning like slow wheels.
lore.legendary: Grew a whole new starfish from one lost arm. The two of them still argue about which one is the original.

lore.common: Grows a tiny bit every year and expects everyone to notice.
lore.uncommon: Builds homes for every fish on the reef and charges no rent at all.
lore.rare: Grows so thickly that fish get lost in it and have to ask for directions.
lore.epic: Built a reef so big that it can be seen from the boats as a rainbow under the water.
lore.legendary: Spawned with every coral on the reef on one moonlit night, and the sea turned into a snow globe.

lore.common: Naps on the reef for so long between swims that the fish have opened a little cafe on its shell.
lore.uncommon: Swims back to the beach where it hatched, every few years, and still remembers the way.
lore.rare: Flapped its flippers once and glided further than the speedboat.
lore.epic: Hatched with a thousand brothers and sisters who all ran into the sea at the same moment. The beach looked like it was moving.
lore.legendary: Swam around every ocean in the world over a long, slow lifetime, and the fish in each one still remember its name.

lore.common: Lands on the beach by tumbling over its own enormous wings, then pretends it meant to.
lore.uncommon: Greets its partner with a clacking beak dance that sounds like two people sword-fighting with chopsticks.
lore.rare: Can glide for hours without a single flap, so it naps in the air and wakes up in a different sea.
lore.epic: Spread its wings across the harbour and every boat thought the sun had gone in.
lore.legendary: Is still raising chicks at seventy and has worn out four sets of leg rings. The scientists bring each new ring as a birthday present.

lore.common: Glides past the glass with its nose in the air, as if the other fish are beneath it.
lore.uncommon: Always swims with the same partner and sulks if anyone else joins the conversation.
lore.rare: Its tall stripy fins make it vanish among the water weeds, then reappear right behind your finger.
lore.epic: Swam so gracefully round the pet shop that customers bought the tank, the weeds and the shop assistant's chair.
lore.legendary: Has kept the same tank spotless for twenty years by staring at every crumb until it leaves on its own.

lore.common: Its filter hums all night, exactly one note lower than the fridge.
lore.uncommon: Grows a new layer of green on the glass every time someone has just cleaned it.
lore.rare: Its bubbler blows so hard that the plastic diver has started riding the bubbles like a lift.
lore.epic: Sprang a tiny leak and turned the living room into a paddling pool. The fish loved the extra space.
lore.legendary: Grew so big and so beautiful that the whole street now visits it at weekends, and the fish wave back.

lore.common: Puffs up and flares its fins at its own reflection, every morning, and loses every time.
lore.uncommon: Builds a little raft of bubbles at the top of the tank and gets very upset if you touch it.
lore.rare: Its silky fins flow like a ballgown, so it refuses to swim anywhere it might get them wet.
lore.epic: Flared at a passing cat so dramatically that the cat backed out of the room and has not returned.
lore.legendary: Built a bubble nest so large that the whole pet shop floated gently up to the ceiling for an afternoon.

lore.common: Throws leaves all over the garden path looking for worms, then glares at you for sweeping.
lore.uncommon: Sings from the top of the chimney every evening as if it's the last concert of the year.
lore.rare: Its alarm call goes chink-chink-chink at every cat, so the cats now creep around in socks.
lore.epic: Stripped every cherry off the orchard the night before picking day. The farmer harvested a lot of stones.
lore.legendary: Taught its evening song to every blackbird in town. Now the whole town goes to bed at exactly the same moment.

lore.common: Flings seed husks out of its cage so the whole room crunches underfoot.
lore.uncommon: Rings the bell on its mirror whenever it wants attention, which is every few seconds.
lore.rare: Learned to say "pretty bird" so many times that the cat has started saying it too.
lore.epic: Escaped from its cage and organised every budgie in the pet shop into a chirping choir.
lore.legendary: Learned a hundred words, then used them all in one sentence, and the family still haven't worked out what it wanted.

lore.common: Sings at full volume the moment you take the cover off its cage, even at six in the morning.
lore.uncommon: Is so yellow that it makes the bananas in the fruit bowl look pale.
lore.rare: Hit a note so high that the glass of water beside the cage started humming along.
lore.epic: Sang so loudly from the open window that the whole street stopped its cars and joined in the chorus.
lore.legendary: Sang one note so long and so beautifully that the morning sun rose ten minutes early to hear the end.

names.legendary: Old Carpington, Grandfish of the Pond

lore.common: Comes to the surface with its mouth open whenever anyone walks past, just in case.
lore.uncommon: Stirs up the mud at the bottom of the pond so nobody can see what it's eating.
lore.rare: Grew so big that the ducks now use it as a floating island to rest on.
lore.epic: Splashed its tail once and every lily pad in the lake did a somersault.
lore.legendary: Has lived in the same palace pond for a hundred years and still remembers everyone who ever fed it a crumb.

names.legendary: Sir Barbel, Whiskers of the Deep River

lore.common: Lies on the riverbed all day feeling around with its whiskers for snacks nobody else wanted.
lore.uncommon: Has taste buds all over its body, so it can taste the mud just by lying in it, and it loves the taste.
lore.rare: Grew so big that fishermen tell stories about it, and every story is slightly bigger than the last.
lore.epic: Wriggled through the mud so hard that the whole river turned to hot chocolate colour for a week.
lore.legendary: Has lived under the old bridge for so long that the town put it on the welcome sign. It still eats the bread meant for the ducks.

names.legendary: Little Clucky, Boss of the Barnyard

lore.common: Cheeps so loudly when it loses sight of its mother that the whole farm goes looking.
lore.uncommon: Follows the first thing it sees after hatching. This one follows the vacuum cleaner.
lore.rare: Pecks at everything shiny, including buttons, zips and the farmer's wristwatch.
lore.epic: Hatched alongside a hundred others in the same morning, and the farmhouse kitchen became a fluffy yellow carpet.
lore.legendary: Hatched, looked around and announced it was in charge. The farmyard has run on time ever since.

lore.common: Snaps shut whenever someone looks at it, then opens again just to check if they've gone.
lore.uncommon: Squirts water from the sand whenever someone walks past, so the beach is full of surprised paddlers.
lore.rare: Digs itself so deep in the sand so fast that spades give up.
lore.epic: Clamped onto a paddler's welly and would not let go, so she spent the whole holiday walking with a loud click.
lore.legendary: Kept a single grain of sand safe for so long that it grew into the largest pearl ever seen. It refuses to let anyone borrow it.

lore.common: Screams in your ear when it wants a cuddle, then screams again when the cuddle ends.
lore.uncommon: Bobs its head and dances whenever music plays, including the microwave timer.
lore.rare: Raises its crest so high when it's surprised that it knocks the lampshade off.
lore.epic: Unscrewed every handle in the kitchen while the family slept. Breakfast took an hour to get into.
lore.legendary: Gives off so much fine feather dust that the whole house looks freshly floured. The bakery next door asked for the recipe.

names.legendary: Codfrey, the Big Fish of the North Sea

lore.common: Swims away very fast whenever anyone mentions chips.
lore.uncommon: Swims in shoals so huge that the fishing boats ask it for directions.
lore.rare: Has a single whisker on its chin and strokes it like a very wise old professor.
lore.epic: Laid millions of eggs in one go, and the North Sea briefly looked like tapioca.
lore.legendary: Outswam every fishing boat in the North Sea for twenty years and now gives swimming lessons to the young cod.

lore.common: Steals shiny bottle caps from the pavement and hides them in the gutter.
lore.uncommon: Drops nuts on the road and waits for cars to crack them, then politely waits at the crossing to collect.
lore.rare: Remembers the face of everyone who has ever shooed it away, and caws at them every morning.
lore.epic: Organised every crow in town into a gang that collects lost keys. The lost-property office is overwhelmed.
lore.legendary: Solved a puzzle that scientists had been stuck on for weeks, using a stick, a stone and a bottle of water.

names.legendary: Dodonna, the Return of the Dodo

lore.common: Trips over its own feet while standing still, then looks round to see who pushed it.
lore.uncommon: Came back from history and is very confused by doorbells.
lore.rare: Waddled into a museum and was moved to the "extinct" display. It refuses to leave.
lore.epic: Waddled through a busy airport looking for its old island. Every flight was delayed to help it.
lore.legendary: Became the most famous bird that nobody has seen in ages, and has started signing autographs anyway.

lore.common: Paddles round and round in circles because it's still working out its feet.
lore.uncommon: Lines up behind its mother and won't take a single step out of order.
lore.rare: Took its first swim and paddled so fast that it overtook the mother duck.
lore.epic: Jumped out of its nest high in a tree and bounced off the lawn like a ball. The neighbours opened a trampoline park in its honour.
lore.legendary: Became the lollipop warden of the park pond, and every duckling crosses safely when it says so.

lore.common: Sits on the highest crag and glares at everyone below as if they owe it money.
lore.uncommon: Can spot a rabbit from two miles up, and a picnic from three.
lore.rare: Snatched a whole fish from a fisherman's line and flew off without saying thank you.
lore.epic: Flapped once over the ski slope, and every skier went down the mountain twice as fast as they meant to.
lore.legendary: Has been drawn on so many flags and shields that it now refuses to be painted from its bad side.

lore.common: Wriggles out of every hand that tries to hold it and leaves only a slimy handprint.
lore.uncommon: Slips through the smallest gap in the riverbank and appears in the neighbour's pond.
lore.rare: Can slither across a wet field from one river to another in the middle of the night.
lore.epic: Wriggled through every drainpipe in the village and came out of every tap at once.
lore.legendary: Swam halfway across the ocean to a sea it had never seen, to visit the place it was born. Sent a postcard home.

lore.common: Peers into every car window at the safari park and steals the sandwich off the dashboard.
lore.uncommon: Makes a deep drumming boom in its chest that sounds like someone knocking on a hollow tree.
lore.rare: Runs so fast on its long legs that it overtakes the jeep that was chasing it.
lore.epic: Walked along a fence for a thousand kilometres looking for a gap, and the farmers named the fence after it.
lore.legendary: Outran a kangaroo, a dingo and a motorbike in the same afternoon. Then stopped to look at a shiny button.

lore.common: Sits on the falconer's glove looking bored, then flies off to chase a pigeon anyway.
lore.uncommon: Wears a little leather hood and pretends it can still see you.
lore.rare: Dives from the sky so fast that it arrives before the sound of its own wings.
lore.epic: Moved onto the tallest office block in the city, and the window cleaners now book appointments around its nap.
lore.legendary: Became the fastest creature on the planet, then spent the afternoon sitting very still on a church spire.

names.legendary: Florida Flamboyance, the Pinkest of All

lore.common: Stands on one leg all day and gets cross when anyone asks about the other one.
lore.uncommon: Stays pink by eating shrimp, and blushes even pinker when you mention it.
lore.rare: Sifts its food upside down with its head in the water, so it always sees the world the wrong way round.
lore.epic: Marched sideways in a tight crowd with a thousand flamingos, and the boating lake had to close for the parade.
lore.legendary: Built a mud nest shaped like a little volcano, and soon every flamingo on the lake copied it. The lake now looks like a tiny mountain range.

lore.common: Makes everything outside look stretched and funny, so the goldfish thinks the cat is enormous.
lore.uncommon: Echoes every tap on the glass so loudly that the goldfish has started tapping back.
lore.rare: Hums when you run a wet finger round its rim, so the goldfish has started requesting songs.
lore.epic: Rolled off the shelf, bounced on the carpet and landed back upright. The goldfish didn't notice.
lore.legendary: Has held the same goldfish for twenty years, and the goldfish still thinks every lap is a brand new holiday.

names.legendary: Gertie, Captain of the Goose Squad

lore.common: Is only a ball of fluff but already hisses at everything like a grown-up goose.
lore.uncommon: Marches behind its parents across the park in perfect step, then gets distracted by a daisy.
lore.rare: Paddled off for its first swim the day it hatched, and spent the afternoon telling the ducks how easy it was.
lore.epic: Led a march of goslings straight through a football match. The referee stopped the game.
lore.legendary: Grew up to lead the biggest goose squad on the river, and nobody has dared feed it the wrong bread since.

lore.common: Is so tiny that it hides behind a single strand of water weed.
lore.uncommon: Has so many babies that the tank looks more crowded every morning.
lore.rare: Flicks its rainbow tail so fast that it leaves a little shimmer in the water behind it.
lore.epic: Its family grew so big that the pet shop had to buy a second aquarium just for its grandchildren.
lore.legendary: Was sent to a tropical island to eat mosquitoes, and ate so many that the island now sleeps without nets.

names.legendary: Screecher Supreme, Voice of Every Eagle

lore.common: Circles over the garden for hours, making the birds at the feeder very nervous.
lore.uncommon: Has a brick-red tail and flicks it like a cape every time it lands on a fence post.
lore.rare: Spotted a mouse in the long grass from the top of a lamp post a mile away.
lore.epic: Circled above the school sports day so long that every child ran the egg-and-spoon race looking up.
lore.legendary: Its screech became so famous that every eagle in every film uses it, and the hawk gets nothing for it.

lore.common: Stands at the edge of the garden pond looking innocent, then steals the goldfish when nobody is looking.
lore.uncommon: Flies with its neck folded into an S, so it always looks like it has just remembered something embarrassing.
lore.rare: Struck a fish so fast that the splash happened after it had already swallowed.
lore.epic: Raided every garden pond in the street in one morning. The goldfish now live in the bath.
lore.legendary: Waited at the same river bend so patiently that the river finally gave up and brought it a fish every morning.

lore.common: Hovers in front of your face, stares, and zips off without saying anything.
lore.uncommon: Can fly backwards, upside down and sideways, and does all three for no reason.
lore.rare: Beats its wings so fast that it hums like a tiny motor and nobody can see the wings at all.
lore.epic: Drank from every flower in the park in one minute and left the bees confused and empty-handed.
lore.legendary: Flew across a whole sea on a body the size of a thumb, then stopped for a single sip of nectar.

lore.common: Sits on a branch over the river looking very important, then dives in and misses.
lore.uncommon: Flashes past so fast that people only see a streak of blue and wonder if they imagined it.
lore.rare: Dives into the water without a single splash, then comes up with a fish every time.
lore.epic: Dived so cleanly that engineers copied its beak for a high-speed train. Now it races the train every morning and wins.
lore.legendary: Dug a tunnel into the riverbank so long that it came out in the village bakery. It now dives for doughnuts.

lore.common: Bumbles around the garden at night poking its long beak into every flowerpot.
lore.uncommon: Has nostrils at the very tip of its beak, so it can smell worms underground.
lore.rare: Laid an egg so enormous compared to its body that the whole forest came to look.
lore.epic: Snuffled so loudly round the campsite at night that every tent zipped itself shut.
lore.legendary: Became the national symbol of a whole country without ever learning to fly. It is very proud of its fuzzy feathers.

names.legendary: Rainbow Rosalind, Loudest in the Jungle

lore.common: Screams so loudly at sunrise that the monkeys put their hands over their ears.
lore.uncommon: Cracks open nuts that the squirrels can't even dent, and leaves the shells everywhere.
lore.rare: Licks the clay riverbank every morning to settle its tummy after too many unripe seeds. Calls it pudding.
lore.epic: Led a flock of macaws over the jungle and the whole sky turned into a moving rainbow.
lore.legendary: Lived for seventy years, learned every word the explorers taught it, and now gives tours of the jungle.

lore.common: Glides past the divers so close that they forget to breathe through their snorkels.
lore.uncommon: Queues politely at the reef's cleaning station while tiny fish tidy its gills.
lore.rare: Leapt clean out of the sea and belly-flopped back with a slap heard on the beach.
lore.epic: Glided over the reef with a hundred friends, and the fish below thought a storm cloud had arrived.
lore.legendary: Has the biggest brain of any fish and recognises itself in a mirror, so it spends ages fixing its fins before every dive.

lore.common: Pokes holes in every ice floe it swims under, so the seals keep falling through.
lore.uncommon: Has a long spiral tusk and insists everyone calls it a sea unicorn.
lore.rare: Uses its tusk to stir up the seabed, then eats whatever pops out in surprise.
lore.epic: Held an underwater jousting match with twenty other narwhals. The icebergs now have notches like a measuring stick.
lore.legendary: Was so convincing as a unicorn that the explorers drew it on every map of the north. It never once corrected them.

lore.common: Spyhops out of the water to stare at the boat, then sinks back down looking unimpressed.
lore.uncommon: Sings in its family's own special dialect, so the orcas next door can't understand the jokes.
lore.rare: Makes waves with its pod to tip seals off the ice floe, then lets them climb back on.
lore.epic: Raced through the fjord with its whole pod so fast that the ferry had to hold onto its passengers.
lore.legendary: Led the family pod for nearly a hundred years, and still decides where everyone has lunch.

lore.common: Is said to hide its head in the sand, but actually just peers at its eggs and pretends nobody can see it.
lore.uncommon: Lays the biggest eggs of any bird, then sits on them looking very proud.
lore.rare: Kicks so hard with its long legs that the safari jeep keeps its distance.
lore.epic: Raced a car across the savannah and won, then turned round to look at it as if it was slow.
lore.legendary: Has eyes bigger than its brain, the biggest of any land animal, and still cannot remember where it put its egg.

names.legendary: Rosa Ringneck, Boss of the City Park

lore.common: Screeches from the treetops in the city park at sunset as if it owns the place.
lore.uncommon: Raids the bird feeders in a green gang of twenty and leaves nothing for the sparrows.
lore.rare: Moved into a cold city park from somewhere warm and has been complaining about the weather ever since.
lore.epic: Arrived with a flock so large that the whole park turned green for a week.
lore.legendary: Built one shared nest for a hundred families in a single tree. The tree was given its own postcode.

lore.common: Chews every pencil, remote and wooden spoon in the house into neat little splinters.
lore.uncommon: Asks for a cracker every time someone opens the cupboard, then throws the cracker on the floor.
lore.rare: Learned to say "who's there?" so you open the door for nobody all day.
lore.epic: Taught every parrot in the pet shop to shout SHOP! at once. The owner has run to the counter four hundred times today.
lore.legendary: Sailed the seven seas on a pirate's shoulder and now gives treasure-hunting tours, mostly to the nearest biscuit tin.

lore.common: Spreads its tail fan in front of every visitor, then screams like someone shouting "help".
lore.uncommon: Struts around the garden checking its reflection in every window.
lore.rare: Its tail feathers are covered in eye patterns, so it can stare at you a hundred times at once.
lore.epic: Fanned its tail at a wedding and the photographer took two hundred pictures of the peacock instead.
lore.legendary: Was so magnificent that the garden designers moved every flower to match its colours.

names.legendary: Pelicandra, the Beak That Holds More

lore.common: Scoops up a whole beakful of water, tips it out, then looks at the one fish left inside.
lore.uncommon: Its beak can hold more than its belly, so it carries a snack for later everywhere it goes.
lore.rare: Swallowed a fisherman's hat by mistake and wore it on its head for the rest of the day.
lore.epic: Herded the fish into the shallows with fifty friends in a perfect horseshoe. The harbour master has asked them to run the fishing fleet.
lore.legendary: Carried an entire picnic, blanket and all, in its pouch across the bay to deliver it to a lonely seagull.

lore.common: Runs across the country lane in front of every car, then stands in the middle wondering why.
lore.uncommon: Its feathers shine copper and green in the sun, so it poses on fence posts for walkers.
lore.rare: Burst out of the hedge so suddenly with a loud clatter that the walkers jumped higher than it flew.
lore.epic: Crowed and clattered its wings so loudly at dawn that every rooster in the valley gave up in shame.
lore.legendary: Strutted so proudly through the village that it was mistaken for a very small peacock and given its own garden.

lore.common: Puffs up into a spiky ball whenever it's startled, then can't fit through the gap it was swimming through.
lore.uncommon: Swims with an adorable little face that makes everyone forget it's covered in spikes.
lore.rare: Inflated so suddenly that the fish that tried to eat it is still trying to work out what happened.
lore.epic: Drew a giant pattern in the sand with its fins to impress a date, and the divers thought aliens had landed.
lore.legendary: Inflated so much that it floated to the surface and drifted around the bay like a spiky beach ball for a week.

lore.common: Waddles along the cliff edge like a tiny clown, then trips over a seagull.
lore.uncommon: Carries ten little fish crosswise in its beak at once and still manages to look smug.
lore.rare: Flaps its wings so fast underwater that it flies through the sea like a submarine.
lore.epic: Dug so many burrows in the cliff that the whole island now sounds hollow when you walk on it.
lore.legendary: Has met the same partner at the same burrow every spring for twenty years, and still brings her a flower, which is a fish.

lore.common: Bobs the little feather on its head with every step, like a very small soldier.
lore.uncommon: Runs in a tight little group with its family, so it looks like a single walking hedge.
lore.rare: Its call sounds so much like "how are you?" that walkers keep answering it.
lore.epic: Laid so many eggs in one spring that the farm shop now sells only tiny boxes.
lore.legendary: Crossed the whole sea at night in one flock, and the lighthouse keeper counted them instead of sheep and slept for a week.

lore.common: Sits on the castle wall cawing at the tourists and stealing their crisps.
lore.uncommon: Learns to copy words and uses them only when it's least helpful.
lore.rare: Slides down snowy roofs on its back just for fun, then flies up and does it again.
lore.epic: Played catch with a fox across the castle lawn for an hour. The tourists cheered and the fox demanded a rematch.
lore.legendary: Guarded an old castle so faithfully that the castle stayed standing for a thousand years. Nobody dared ask it to leave.

lore.common: Turns up at the river mouth every autumn and waits for the tide like it is queuing for a bus.
lore.uncommon: Was born in a river, grew up in the sea, and still complains that the sea is far too salty.
lore.rare: Leapt into a fisherman's boat by mistake, looked around, and leapt straight back out.
lore.epic: Leapt up the salmon ladder so fast that the fish counter at the dam ran out of numbers.
lore.legendary: Found its way back to the exact pebble where it hatched, after years at sea, and was surprised to find its old name still written there.

lore.common: Swims by clapping its shell shut, so it always sounds like it's applauding itself.
lore.uncommon: Has a row of tiny blue eyes along its shell edge and blinks them all at once.
lore.rare: Grows a new ring on its shell every year, so it knows its exact age and announces it at every birthday.
lore.epic: Started a clapping chorus on the seabed with a thousand scallops. The fishermen thought it was raining.
lore.legendary: Clapped so enthusiastically at a dolphin's show that it was invited to be the official audience of the bay.

lore.common: Soaks up all the water in the rockpool and leaves the crabs high and dry.
lore.uncommon: Squeezes itself out whenever someone touches it, then soaks it all back up when they leave.
lore.rare: Drank in so much seawater that it doubled in size, then squeezed it all onto a passing diver.
lore.epic: Pumped so much seawater through itself in one day that the tide came in ten minutes late.
lore.legendary: Filtered an entire bay clean in one summer, then squeezed out the last drop over the mayor's head.

lore.common: Snatches the chip out of your hand just as you lift it to your mouth, then stares as if you dropped it.
lore.uncommon: Stamps its feet on the grass like it's doing a rain dance, until the worms come up.
lore.rare: Screams on the rooftop at four in the morning so the whole seaside town wakes before the fishermen.
lore.epic: Led every gull on the coast in one swoop down the promenade. No ice cream survived.
lore.legendary: Collected a dropped chip from every beach on the coast in one summer and built a tower of them on the pier.

lore.common: Curls its tail round a piece of seaweed and refuses to let go, even when the tide wants it to.
lore.uncommon: The dad carries the babies in his pouch, and complains about it every single day.
lore.rare: Swims upright so slowly that it once lost a race to a snail.
lore.epic: Led a herd of seahorses across the seagrass in a slow, perfectly upright gallop.
lore.legendary: Changed colour to match every shade of seaweed in the bay. The divers have been looking for it since last summer.

names.legendary: Sturnella, Painter of the Evening Sky

lore.common: Copies car alarms and phone ringtones so perfectly that the street keeps checking its pockets.
lore.uncommon: Its speckled feathers shimmer purple and green in the sunlight like oil on water.
lore.rare: Walks across the lawn stabbing its beak in and opening it wide, like a very busy garden fork.
lore.epic: Swirled through the evening sky with a million starlings in a shape like a giant dancing cloud.
lore.legendary: Copied the ice-cream van tune so perfectly that every child on the estate ran outside. The van is thinking about a new song.

lore.common: Hides under the sand in the shallows, so paddlers jump every time it shuffles.
lore.uncommon: Glides along the seabed so smoothly that the crabs think it's a moving carpet.
lore.rare: Sucks clams out of the sand like a vacuum cleaner and leaves the empty shells in a tidy pile.
lore.epic: Shuffled out of the sand with a hundred friends and the whole sandbank seemed to start moving.
lore.legendary: Glided so gently around the bay for so long that the swimmers learned to shuffle their feet to say hello.

lore.common: Follows the tractor around the field all day waiting for it to dig up worms.
lore.uncommon: Has long red legs that look like stilts and walks as if it's on stage.
lore.rare: Has no real voice, so it clatters its beak like a wooden rattle whenever it wants to join a conversation.
lore.epic: Built a nest on top of an electricity pylon so big that the engineers added a special platform just for it.
lore.legendary: Flew from one end of a continent to the other without getting lost once, then landed in the same field as last year.

lore.common: Swoops so low over the garden that it skims the washing on the line.
lore.uncommon: Builds its mud nest in the barn rafters and expects the cows to keep quiet.
lore.rare: Flies so low before rain that the farmers take in their hay when they see it.
lore.epic: Arrived with a whole flock on the same morning and everyone declared summer had begun.
lore.legendary: Flew all the way from the other side of the world to return to the same barn, then complained the barn had been painted.

lore.common: Points its sword at every boat it meets, as if challenging them to a duel.
lore.uncommon: Swims so fast that it leaves little bubbles behind its sword.
lore.rare: Sliced through a shoal of fish so quickly that the shoal didn't notice it was now two shoals.
lore.epic: Warms its own eyes to see in the cold deep sea, and spotted a lost anchor from half a mile away.
lore.legendary: Won a duel against a sailing ship's mast. The ship now sails with a small notch and a big story.

lore.common: Tosses berries into the air and catches them in its huge beak, missing most of them.
lore.uncommon: Its beak is so big and colourful that it looks like it's carrying a banana everywhere.
lore.rare: Flipped a mango into the air, caught it, and flicked the stone straight into the zookeeper's tea.
lore.epic: Shook a fruit tree so hard that it showered fruit on every monkey below. The monkeys threw a party.
lore.legendary: Uses its huge beak as a radiator to cool down, and kept the whole jungle hut chilly all summer.

names.legendary: Old Speckle, Wisest Fish in the Stream

lore.common: Rises to every fly on the water except the one with the hook in it.
lore.uncommon: Its rainbow stripes shimmer under the river ripples so nobody can quite tell where it is.
lore.rare: Leapt clean over the angler's net and splashed back right behind him.
lore.epic: Rose to a whole swarm of flies at sunset and every fisherman on the river forgot to cast.
lore.legendary: Swam up the waterfall into the mountain lake and has been its only fish for so long that it thinks it invented water.

lore.common: Swims so fast that it overshoots the snack it was chasing, every single time.
lore.uncommon: Keeps itself warm in cold water like a little furnace, and boasts about it to the shivering fish.
lore.rare: Zoomed across the ocean so quickly that it beat the cargo ship to the harbour.
lore.epic: Led a shoal so fast across the sea that the surface looked like it was boiling.
lore.legendary: Swam across an entire ocean in a few weeks, then turned round because it forgot something.

lore.common: Gobbles loudly at anything that makes a noise, including the telephone.
lore.uncommon: Its red wattle wobbles with every step, and it shakes it at you when it's cross.
lore.rare: Fanned its tail feathers so proudly at a farm visit that every child took a photo.
lore.epic: Gobbled at the farmyard until every animal on the farm gobbled back. The farmer thinks he's going mad.
lore.legendary: Strutted so proudly through the market that the stallholders gave it free corn just to make it stop showing off.

lore.common: Spreads its huge wings in the morning sun to warm up, as if it is waiting for a round of applause.
lore.uncommon: Has a bald head so it never has to wash its hair after dinner.
lore.rare: Can spot a picnic from miles up and arrives just as the sandwiches come out.
lore.epic: Rode one warm air current with fifty friends, and the hot-air balloons had to queue behind them.
lore.legendary: Cleaned up after every lion, hyena and picnic on the savannah for a whole summer. The savannah has never been tidier.

names.legendary: Rhincodonna, Biggest Fish in the Sea

lore.common: Swims with its mouth wide open and accidentally swallows a lot of seaweed.
lore.uncommon: Is the biggest fish in the ocean but only eats the tiniest things in it. Its dinner plate would be a thimble.
lore.rare: Swam so close to the divers that they could count its spots, and they all lost count.
lore.epic: Swam slowly through the bay with fifty little fish riding underneath it like passengers on a bus.
lore.legendary: Swam so slowly past the dive boat that the divers had lunch, a nap and a second dive before its tail went by.

lore.common: Drums on the drainpipe at six in the morning because it's louder than the tree.
lore.uncommon: Its tongue wraps right round inside its head, so it never gets a headache from drumming.
lore.rare: Hammered so many holes in the shed that it now has better air conditioning than the house.
lore.epic: Drummed on every tree in the forest at once, and the whole wood sounded like a marching band.
lore.legendary: Drilled a perfect round window in the old oak tree, then charged the owls rent for the view.
